test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in bold in the following sentence.

Her father was quick to detect her **concealed **emotion.
solution:
The correct answer is 'disclosed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym for the given word 'concealed' is 'disclosed'.
 
• The meaning of the word 'concealed' is '**kept secret; hidden**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**disclosed**' is '**make (secret or new information) known**'.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'disclosed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Annoyed- slightly angry; irritated.
 
• Arrogant- having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.
 
• Excited- very enthusiastic and eager.
